request.query:
DEFINE MEASURE 'Complaint Cohorts'[Eligible Window Count] = VAR _selectedDates = CALCULATETABLE(VALUES('Date'[Date]), ALLSELECTED('Date'))
VAR _ends = VALUES('Review Window'[Window End])
VAR _minimum = IF(NOT ISFILTERED('Review Minimum'), 100,
    IF(HASONEVALUE('Review Minimum'[Minimum]), SELECTEDVALUE('Review Minimum'[Minimum]), BLANK()))
VAR _companies = VALUES('Company'[Company Key])
VAR _products = VALUES('Product'[Product Key])
VAR _issues = VALUES('Issue'[Issue Key])
VAR _identities = SELECTCOLUMNS(ALL('Review Selection'),
    "__key", 'Review Selection'[Selection Key], "__segment", 'Review Selection'[Segment Key],
    "__company", 'Review Selection'[Company Key] + 0,
    "__product", 'Review Selection'[Product Key] + 0,
    "__issue", 'Review Selection'[Issue Key] + 0,
    "__end", EDATE('Review Selection'[Window End], 0))
VAR _candidates = FILTER(_identities, [__end] IN _ends && [__company] IN _companies &&
    [__product] IN _products && [__issue] IN _issues)
VAR _grouped = CALCULATETABLE(
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Company'[Company Key], 'Product'[Product Key],
        'Issue'[Issue Key], 'Date'[Month Start],
        "__fc", SUM('Complaint Cohorts'[Complaint Rows]),
        "__fk", SUM('Complaint Cohorts'[Yes Rows]) + SUM('Complaint Cohorts'[No Rows]),
        "__fn", SUM('Complaint Cohorts'[No Rows]),
        "__tc", IGNORE(CALCULATE(SUM('Complaint Cohorts'[Complaint Rows]), REMOVEFILTERS('Issue'))),
        "__tk", IGNORE(CALCULATE(SUM('Complaint Cohorts'[Yes Rows]) + SUM('Complaint Cohorts'[No Rows]), REMOVEFILTERS('Issue'))),
        "__tn", IGNORE(CALCULATE(SUM('Complaint Cohorts'[No Rows]), REMOVEFILTERS('Issue')))),
    REMOVEFILTERS('Review Selection'), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'),
    TREATAS(_selectedDates, 'Date'[Date]))
VAR _withPeers = ADDCOLUMNS(_grouped,
    "__pc", [__tc] - [__fc], "__pk", [__tk] - [__fk], "__pn", [__tn] - [__fn])
VAR _sparse = FILTER(_withPeers,
    VAR _month = 'Date'[Month Start]
    VAR _next = EDATE(_month, 1)
    RETURN _month <> DATE(2023,8,1) &&
        COUNTROWS(FILTER(_selectedDates, 'Date'[Date] >= _month && 'Date'[Date] < _next)) = DAY(EOMONTH(_month,0)) &&
        [__fc] >= 50 && [__pc] >= 50 && [__fk] > 0 && [__pk] > 0)
VAR _monthly = ADDCOLUMNS(_sparse, "__elevated",
    INT(100 * ([__fn] * [__pk] - [__pn] * [__fk]) >= [__fk] * [__pk]))
VAR _shift0 = SELECTCOLUMNS(_monthly, "__company", 'Company'[Company Key] + 0,
    "__product", 'Product'[Product Key] + 0,
    "__issue", 'Issue'[Issue Key] + 0,
    "__end", EDATE('Date'[Month Start], 0),
    "__m0fc", [__fc],
    "__m0fk", [__fk],
    "__m0fn", [__fn],
    "__m0pc", [__pc],
    "__m0pk", [__pk],
    "__m0pn", [__pn],
    "__m0elevated", [__elevated])
VAR _shift1 = SELECTCOLUMNS(_monthly, "__company", 'Company'[Company Key] + 0,
    "__product", 'Product'[Product Key] + 0,
    "__issue", 'Issue'[Issue Key] + 0,
    "__end", EDATE('Date'[Month Start], 1),
    "__m1fc", [__fc],
    "__m1fk", [__fk],
    "__m1fn", [__fn],
    "__m1pc", [__pc],
    "__m1pk", [__pk],
    "__m1pn", [__pn],
    "__m1elevated", [__elevated])
VAR _shift2 = SELECTCOLUMNS(_monthly, "__company", 'Company'[Company Key] + 0,
    "__product", 'Product'[Product Key] + 0,
    "__issue", 'Issue'[Issue Key] + 0,
    "__end", EDATE('Date'[Month Start], 2),
    "__m2fc", [__fc],
    "__m2fk", [__fk],
    "__m2fn", [__fn],
    "__m2pc", [__pc],
    "__m2pk", [__pk],
    "__m2pn", [__pn],
    "__m2elevated", [__elevated])
VAR _windows = NATURALINNERJOIN(NATURALINNERJOIN(_shift0, _shift1), _shift2)
VAR _joined = NATURALINNERJOIN(_candidates, _windows)
VAR _statistics = ADDCOLUMNS(_joined,
    "__complete", TRUE(), "__era", TRUE(), "__known", TRUE(),
    "__volume", MIN(MIN([__m0fc], [__m0pc]), MIN(MIN([__m1fc], [__m1pc]), MIN([__m2fc], [__m2pc]))), "__elevated", [__m0elevated] + [__m1elevated] + [__m2elevated],
    "__no", [__m0fn] + [__m1fn] + [__m2fn], "__knownCount", [__m0fk] + [__m1fk] + [__m2fk],
    "__peerNo", [__m0pn] + [__m1pn] + [__m2pn], "__peerKnown", [__m0pk] + [__m1pk] + [__m2pk],
    "__complaints", [__m0fc] + [__m1fc] + [__m2fc])
VAR _evaluated = ADDCOLUMNS(_statistics,
    "__eligible", NOT ISBLANK(_minimum) && [__volume] >= _minimum,
    "__stable", [__volume] >= 200 && [__elevated] >= 2)
VAR _qualified = FILTER(_evaluated, [__eligible] && [__elevated] >= 2)
RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(_minimum), COALESCE(COUNTROWS(FILTER(_evaluated, [__eligible])),0),BLANK())
EVALUATE ROW("eligible", [Eligible Window Count])
